mainText: The four 'what next?' scenarios for Premier League after Man City ruling. It has taken more than two years, but a judgement finally appears to have been made on the 115 charges levelled against Manchester City. Here's what it means. A 31-year wait for success - but can Everton fans still celebrate?. Is supporting Everton a life of misery, or are there still reasons to celebrate? Chief football writer Phil McNulty seeks the answer. Award-winner to fourth choice - what has gone wrong for Ramsdale?. From challenging for the Premier League with Arsenal and playing for England, Aaron Ramsdale is now Southampton's fourth-choice goalkeeper.

mainText: Watch: Were the RAF Fairford arrests 'pure luck'?. Five men have been arrested on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offences after a major incident was declared at an airbase in the west of England. UK diesel price hits all-time high, RAC says. The US-Israel war with Iran has caused fuel prices to soar. Thousands of illegal ghost plates on cars revealed by new cameras. Illegal registration plates are far too easy to get hold of and are putting the public at risk, BBC is told. Police block Protestant Orange Order from controversial parade route. They had been unable to make the permitted parade on Sunday morning because protesters had gathered on the mainly-nationalist Garvaghy Road.
